title: ID0422052-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R7 170002203] Charger is not able to load the image
description:
Reported issue: We do not see it in SCB even though teltonika is connected and we can ping 8.8.8.8. Charger is not able to load the image properly leaving us only with Hello Hallo screen after loading. Because of that issue CPO can´t operate this charger since they do not see it in backend. EcoG is connected properly and communicates.
